string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: Backup & Restore: save your projects, files, chats and settings into one file. Find it in Settings.
Add a password to also save your API keys and logins (GitHub, git, SSH, coding agents).
Restoring adds the backup\'s projects next to the ones on your phone, so nothing here is lost.
After a reinstall, restore from the setup screen to get everything back.
Backups keep running with the screen off and show live progress.
